workflow.name: OLEANDER Blender Professional FreeCAD Oblique Face Rotate

authority_chain.selector: SELECTOR::LOCAL_POS_X_FACE resolved from yaw-transformed world normal
authority_chain.axis: AXIS::SELECTED_FACE_CENTER::LOCAL_POS_Y resolved as transformed local tangent axis
authority_chain.kernel_route: TopoShape.replaceShape / BRepTools_ReShape with sew/fix normalization and shell-to-solid rebuild when required

bounded_scope: R001 rectangular prism 80x50x10 mm yawed +30 degrees and selected local +X face rotated +5 degrees
R002 rectangular prism 100x60x12 mm yawed -25 degrees and selected local +X face rotated -5 degrees
semantic local +X planar face is re-resolved from transformed world normal after dimension and yaw changes
semantic rotation axis is selected-face center transformed local +Y tangent axis, not fixed world X/Y/Z
world rotation-axis direction changes across R001/R002 while stable semantic axis ID is preserved
actual selected-face normal validates signed +5/-5 degree rotation within numerical tolerance
target face plus four adjacent faces are replaced through BRepTools_ReShape while opposite face is not replaced
both revisions remain valid one-solid six-face B-Rep results
opposite face center and area remain unchanged
zero angle, angle greater than 15 degrees, axis containing selected-face normal component, and selector miss all fail before accepted mutation
FCStd plus R001/R002 STEP artifacts persist selector/axis/yaw/angle/authority metadata
Blender creates two tessellated display-only derivatives and preserves source hash/selector/axis/yaw/angle/authority across .blend save/reopen
invalidation_rule: Invalidate this bounded validation if semantic selector/axis IDs are replaced by raw topology indices, the axis becomes fixed world-axis logic, signed angle/failure gates are removed, source geometry authority moves to mesh-only mutation, or source authority no longer survives Blender readback.
authority_note: This receipt proves a bounded yaw-oblique planar face rotation about a semantic local tangent axis. It does not prove arbitrary user-defined axis, full-3D face orientation, nonplanar rotation or P0-B PASS.
